name: Spring Flamingo
dof_breakdown: actuated hip, knee and ankle on each leg; boom-constrained to the sagittal plane
summary: Jerry Pratt's planar walker, and the first Leg Lab robot with feet and actuated ankles — the pieces a machine needs to walk rather than hop. Series Elastic Actuators and Virtual Model Control let it exploit the natural dynamics of a compliant ankle and a kneecap instead of fighting them. It beat every goal set for it: 1.2 m/s against a 0.75 m/s target, joint power as low as 15 watts, and more than 200 successful demonstrations covering over 15 miles of walking, shrugging off blows from a pugil stick.
notable: First Leg Lab robot with feet and active ankles
Walked at 1.2 m/s on as little as 15 W of joint power
Later offered commercially through Yobotics, the lab's spin-out
